name: Self Will And Stubbornness
overview: Scripture reveals that self will and stubbornness are marked by a hardened, stiffnecked attitude that resists God's guidance and grace, as seen in the repeated description of the Israelites in Exodus and Deuteronomy. This obstinacy leads to sin and divine judgment, yet also calls for earnest prayer for forgiveness and mercy, exemplified in Moses' intercession. The persistent refusal to hearken to God and His messengers demonstrates a dangerous pride that separates people from the blessings intended for them.
